# Murivest Auctions (auctions.murivest.com)

> Commercial and investment property auction intelligence for Kenya and the
> United Kingdom, published by Murivest Group Ltd — a commercial real estate
> services firm providing brokerage, property and asset management, and
> investment property services across East Africa, the United Kingdom and
> international markets. Murivest acts as buyer-side auction brokerage: it
> publishes verified auction intelligence and represents buyers under separate
> mandate. Murivest Group Ltd is not an auctioneer, does not receive binding
> bids, does not hold deposits, and does not act as principal in any auction
> transaction.

## About

Murivest Group Ltd aggregates, verifies and presents property auction
opportunities and represents buyers through the acquisition process.
Buyer brokerage fee: 2% of the final purchase price, payable by the
successful buyer after the 10% deposit of the purchase price paid to the
selling party under the auction conditions. All engagements are by mandate
only and subject to KYC/AML verification. The selling institution and
appointed auctioneer for each lot are identified in the formal auction
notice issued to registered bidders. Guide prices are not valuations.

## Markets

- Kenya (/kenya): bank chargee sales, receiver sales and private treaty
  lots. Governed by the Land Act 2012 (s.90: 90-day notice of default;
  s.96 as amended 2016: notification of sale at least 40 days before sale)
  and the Auctioneers Act (Cap 526) and Auctioneers Rules 1997. Deposits
  and completion periods are set by each sale's conditions (Murivest-listed
  sales require a 10% deposit). Stamp duty 4% of market value within
  municipalities, 2% outside; capital gains tax 15% (as at writing).
- United Kingdom (/uk): commercial investment lots across London and
  regional UK, under RICS Common Auction Conditions and standard
  commercial property conditions. 10% deposit on exchange; unconditional
  contracts on the fall of the hammer.

## Content

- /auctions — all verified lots, filterable by market, region, asset type,
  status and price
- /calendar — upcoming auctions by date and market
- /how-auctions-work — buying, selling, legal pack and glossary guides
- /intelligence — the research library: 46 articles across six subject
  clusters (auction defence & borrowers, how auctions actually work, trusts
  & asset structuring, buying at auction, finance & due diligence, buyer
  representation & fees) plus Kenya and UK market analysis
- /buyer-fees — the 2% buyer brokerage model with worked examples (KES
  10m → 200k; 50m → 1m; 100m → 2m)
- /faqs — answers on how Kenyan auctions work, who pays what, deposits,
  financing, due diligence and foreign buyer rules
- /tools — free institutional-grade calculators: return (net yield,
  cash-on-cash, DSCR, levered IRR), underwriting gates, and loan repayment.
  All calculations run client-side; no data is stored.
- Auction and off-market alerts: registered buyers are notified through the
  client portal at https://portal.murivest.com (this public site hosts no
  accounts).

## Listing facts

Each listing states the sale mechanism, auction date, guide price, tenure,
legal pack status, a full property facts set (price, NOI, gross rent where
disclosed, building area, occupancy), derived investment metrics (net
yield, payback, ROI, GRM), jurisdiction-appropriate conditions of sale, and
a verification summary. Where gross annual rent is not disclosed by the
selling party, GRM is shown as "Not disclosed."

## Legal disclosure

Auction disclosure. Murivest Group Ltd provides commercial real estate
services and publishes auction intelligence. Murivest is not the auctioneer
and does not act as principal in any auction transaction. Bid registrations
submitted through this website are expressions of buyer intent, are not
binding bids, and are routed by Murivest to the authorised sale channel.
Deposits payable under the auction conditions are paid to the selling
party, not to Murivest. Murivest acts for buyers under a separate
engagement and charges the successful purchaser a brokerage fee of 2% of
the final purchase price, payable after the 10% deposit. Guide prices are
not valuations. All lots are subject to the selling party's terms, due
diligence, and formal contract. This information does not constitute an
offer, solicitation, or investment advice. All engagements are by mandate
only and subject to KYC/AML verification.
